notes.title: Controller Update and Music
notes.notes:
Hi all,

So there is a small update just to refine some controls being used on both keyboards and controllers.  Now Up and W can be used as jump (for people determined to play with just one hand), as well as diving now being the same button press as stinging, for those of you using controllers.

Some debugging has also been going on to help with portals disappearing and game crashes, but please post any further issues that come up!

Achievements are not far off!

On a further note, if you have enjoyed the soundtrack you may be interested to find it here for free download:

https://soundcloud.com/user-146780811/sets/the-bears-and-bees-ost

Thanks for all the kind words and support.

Faithfully,
Damsel Stone.

notes.title: Thanks, Updates, and General Launchy Stuff!
notes.notes:
Very exciting (and still a little surreal) to be live now!  Thanks for the immediate feedback with the kind words and issues with bugs (not the fun, hand-drawn kind, but game-breaking kind).  These shall be fixed imminently.

As for achievements, it is likely that these will be added soon, so watch this space!

Humbly,
Damsel Stone.
